fast.why: Tomorrow is Monday, when deeds are presented to Allah. Make your niyyah tonight before Subuh (Shafi'i).

blessing: Your own two feet carrying you through the day: mobility is a blessing we only notice when it's gone. Today, say Alhamdulillah after your first steps and give a small sadaqah.

verse.text: But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it].

hadith.text: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Look at those who are below you and do not look at those above you, for that is more likely to keep you from belittling the favours of Allah upon you."

lesson.title: Aqidah: belief in the angels
lesson.text: Belief in the angels is the second pillar of iman. In the hadith of Jibril, the Prophet ﷺ said iman is to believe in Allah, His angels, His books, His messengers, the Last Day and the divine decree (Muslim 8). Angels are created from light and obey Allah without fail; two record our deeds each day. Remember that nothing you do, including patience at work, goes unwritten.

name.text: "O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous?" (82:6). His gifts come before we ask; count one today.
"He is Allah... the Sovereign, the Pure, the Perfection (As-Salam)" (59:23). Ask Him for a calm night and let go of the day's tension.

world.text: Bulletin of the Atomic Scientists set it at 85 seconds to midnight on 27 Jan 2026, the closest ever, citing nuclear risk, AI and great-power rivalry.
Forecasters' chance of a 'World War Three' before 2050 (10M+ deaths, major powers involved).
Prof Jiang's latest lectures on geopolitics and where great-power conflict is heading.

Nuclear deterrence makes all-out war a losing move for every major power, so the stable outcome (flashing) is 'compete, don't fight': trade wars, arms races and proxy conflicts. The real danger is a misread in a crisis like Taiwan or Ukraine, which is why the clock and the forecast are rising. Meter: 2 of 5.
